hero.subtitle: Manage work orders, dispatch teams, track field agents in real-time, and delight customers — all from one powerful AI-driven platform.

features.title: Everything You Need to Run Your Field Operations
features.subtitle: From service requests to invoicing, FieldForce Pro gives your team the tools to deliver outstanding field service at scale.

pillar1.desc: Create, assign, and track work orders through every stage with AI-powered automation.

pillar2.title: Smart Scheduling
pillar2.desc: AI-optimized dispatching and scheduling for maximum technician efficiency.

pillar3.title: Invoicing & Payments
pillar3.desc: Generate invoices from work orders and accept payments right from the field.

pillar4.title: Mobile Workforce
pillar4.desc: Empower your field teams with a powerful mobile app for offline-first operations.

hiw.title: Get Up and Running in Minutes
hiw.subtitle: FieldForce Pro streamlines your entire field service workflow from start to finish.

step1.title: Receive Request
step1.desc: Capture service requests from web forms, phone calls, or email — all funneled into one unified inbox.

step2.title: Create & Estimate
step2.desc: Build detailed estimates with your pricebook and get instant customer approval with digital signatures.

step3.title: Dispatch & Execute
step3.desc: AI assigns the best-matched technician, optimizes routes, and tracks progress in real-time.

step4.title: Invoice & Get Paid
step4.desc: Auto-generate invoices from completed work orders, collect payments on-site, and close jobs instantly.

solutions.title: Built for Every Aspect of Field Service
solutions.subtitle: Deep-dive into the features that make FieldForce Pro the most complete FSM platform.

h1.title: End-to-End Work Order Management
h1.desc: Track every job from initial request to completion with our comprehensive work order system. Automate status transitions, enforce SLA compliance, and keep your team aligned at every step.

f1.title: Status Workflow Engine
f1.desc: Configurable workflows: New, Estimated, Approved, Scheduled, In Progress, Completed

f2.title: Job Sheets & Checklists
f2.desc: Custom templates ensure consistent service delivery every time

f3.title: Automated Maintenance
f3.desc: Schedule recurring jobs and preventive maintenance plans

h2.title: AI-Powered Smart Dispatch
h2.desc: Let our AI engine optimize technician assignments based on skills, location, availability, and job priority. See everything on a real-time dispatch board with drag-and-drop simplicity.

f1.title: Skill-Based Matching
f1.desc: Auto-assign technicians based on certifications and expertise

f2.title: Live GPS Tracking
f2.desc: Track your field team in real-time on an interactive map

f3.title: Automated Notifications
f3.desc: Keep customers informed with real-time ETAs and status updates

h3.title: Get Paid Faster with Automated Invoicing
h3.desc: Convert completed work orders into invoices with a single click. Support for multi-currency, tax calculation, online payments, and customizable PDF templates.

f1.title: One-Click Invoicing
f1.desc: Auto-populate from work orders with labor, parts, and expenses

f2.title: Secure Online Payments
f2.desc: Accept credit cards, bank transfers, and digital wallets

f3.title: Revenue Dashboard
f3.desc: Track earnings, overdue invoices, and financial health at a glance

h4.title: Your Office in Your Pocket
h4.desc: Give your field technicians everything they need on the go. The FieldForce Pro mobile app works offline, syncs automatically, and puts the full power of the platform in their hands.

f1.title: Offline-First Architecture
f1.desc: Full functionality even without internet — syncs when back online

f2.title: Vision AI
f2.desc: Snap photos of equipment for instant AI-powered diagnostics

f3.title: Voice Notes
f3.desc: Record voice notes that are auto-transcribed and attached to jobs

testimonials.title: Loved by Service Teams Worldwide
testimonials.subtitle: See how businesses like yours are transforming their field operations with FieldForce Pro.

t1.text: FieldForce Pro transformed how we manage our 50+ technicians. The AI-powered dispatching alone saved us 12 hours per week on scheduling. The real-time tracking gives us full visibility.
t1.author: Michael Rodriguez

t2.text: The mobile app is a game-changer for our field team. They can access job details, capture photos, and get customer signatures — even offline. Our first-time fix rate jumped to 94%.
t2.author: Sarah Chen

t3.text: We went from Excel spreadsheets to a fully automated FSM system in just two weeks. The invoicing integration means we get paid 3x faster. Best investment we've made this year.
t3.author: David Kim
